name: ZC & ZS Backwardation vs Contango Regime Study
description: Analyzes backwardation vs contango regimes in Corn (ZC) and Soybean (ZS) futures. For each market: tracks carry (M1/M2 - 1) over time, measures how often each market is in backwardation, detects regime flips as event markers, and tests whether the current regime predicts the next quarter's carry level (forward carry << 63). Uses NoAdjustment for meaningful carry signals and LiquidityBased rollover.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZC & ZS BACKWARDATION vs CONTANGO REGIME STUDY
# =============================================================================
#
# QUESTIONS ANSWERED:
#   1. How often is each market in backwardation vs contango?
#   2. Does the current regime predict the next quarter's carry level?
#
# DESIGN:
#   - Both ZC and ZS in assets[] — symmetric formula per asset
#   - NoAdjustment: raw prices needed for meaningful M1/M2 carry signal
#   - LiquidityBased rollover: safest default, avoids OI sawtooth artifacts
#   - spread_depth=1: enables cont.spread (M1 - M2 calendar spread)
#   - Regime = carry > 0 (backwardation) / carry < 0 (contango), raw instantaneous
#   - Forward carry = carry << 63 (lead operator, NOT forward_returns — avoids
#     division by near-zero carry at regime crossings per S46)
#   - event_marker fires on each regime flip (crossover/crossunder of carry vs 0)
#
# NARRATIVE ARC:
#   1. CONTEXT    — Carry time series with zero reference line
#   2. EVENT MAP  — Regime flip event markers (backwardation ↔ contango)
#   3. PUNCHLINE  — Grouped bars: avg forward carry by current regime
#   4. REFERENCE  — Summary table: regime frequency, current carry, current regime
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: primary asset via market_data_source + futures_continuation ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Core signals ---
carry = cont.carry          # M1/M2 - 1: positive = backwardation, negative = contango
close = cont.c

# --- Regime classification ---
# Instantaneous: backwardation when carry > 0
is_backwardation = carry > 0
is_contango = carry < 0

# Regime label for bar chart grouping (1 = backwardation, 2 = contango)
regime_num = 1 if is_backwardation else 2

# --- Forward carry: what is carry 63 trading days from now? ---
# Using lead operator (<<) per S46 — avoids division by near-zero carry
fwd_carry_63 = carry << 63

# --- Regime flip detection for event markers ---
# crossover/crossunder are built-in functions
flip_to_backwardation = crossover(carry, 0.0)
flip_to_contango = crossunder(carry, 0.0)
any_flip = flip_to_backwardation or flip_to_contango

# Regime direction label for event card badge
regime_label = 'Backwardation' if is_backwardation else 'Contango'

# --- Regime frequency: fraction of bars in backwardation ---
# Use ternary 1.0/0.0 (not where()) so cumulative Mean gives hit rate
is_back_float = 1.0 if is_backwardation else 0.0
backwardation_rate = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(is_back_float)

# --- Timestamp for x-axis ---
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1 (REFERENCE): Summary Table — Regime Snapshot
# Shows: current carry, current regime, % days in backwardation
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Term Structure Regime Snapshot',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Current', 'Historical'],
        col_headers=['Carry (M1/M2-1)', 'Regime', '% Days Backwardation'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='Current carry level', grid_row=0, grid_col=0,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Current regime (1=Backwardation, 2=Contango)',
                       grid_row=0, grid_col=1,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(info='Fraction of all bars in backwardation (expanding)',
                       grid_row=0, grid_col=2,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Period high carry', grid_row=1, grid_col=0,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Period low carry', grid_row=1, grid_col=1,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Avg carry across full period',
                       grid_row=1, grid_col=2,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    ),
    category='Term Structure Regimes',
    order=0
)(carry, regime_num, backwardation_rate, carry, carry, carry)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2 (CONTEXT): Carry Time Series
# Shows carry level over time with zero reference line
# Regime visible at a glance: above zero = backwardation, below = contango
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Carry Signal Over Time (Backwardation > 0, Contango < 0)',
    category='Term Structure Regimes',
    y_axis_label='Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry', color=Color.Blue, area=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero (Regime Boundary)')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(carry,))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3 (PUNCHLINE): Does regime predict next quarter's carry?
# Grouped bars: avg forward carry (63d) when currently in backwardation vs contango
# Answers: "If I'm in backwardation today, is carry still positive in 63 days?"
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Does Current Regime Predict Next Quarter Carry? (Avg Fwd Carry by Regime)',
    category='Term Structure Regimes',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Exact,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Carry (63d)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=fwd_carry_63, label=regime_num)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4 (EVENT MAP): Regime Flip Event Markers
# Each flip (backwardation ↔ contango) becomes a clickable event card
# Card shows: carry at flip, direction badge, close price
# =============================================================================
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='New Regime', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry at Flip', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, carry, close, any_flip)
